steps.text: Entry Point: Navigate to “Consent Management” under the profile settings
If no consent is granted the following screen will be displayed “You do not have any consent granted”

If customer has granted consent via the web, the following information will be displayed:
- Consent type (AIS: Account information Service, CAF: Customer availably of funds, PIS
- TPP Name
- Expiry date
- Consent initiation date
- Consent status
- Revoke option
More details will be displayed upon clicking on each consent as the shared accounts in the third image.
Customer can revoke an active consent as following image.
